## Add

```bash
zweb add toast
```

## Imports

Styled registry component:

```tsx
import { Toast } from '@/components/ui/toast'
```

Primitive React wrapper:

```tsx
import { Toast } from '@zeus-web/toast/react'
```

Web Component entry:

```ts
import '@zeus-web/toast/wc/auto'
```

## Props

| Prop          | Type                                                  | Default | Description                            |
| ------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- | ------- | -------------------------------------- |
| `open`        | `boolean`                                             | -       | Controlled open state.                 |
| `defaultOpen` | `boolean`                                             | -       | Initial uncontrolled open state.       |
| `duration`    | `number`                                              | -       | Auto-dismiss duration in milliseconds. |
| `status`      | `ToastStatus`<br />Values: `foreground`, `background` | -       | Live-region announcement priority.     |

## Events

| Event         | React prop     | Detail                               | Description                      |
| ------------- | -------------- | ------------------------------------ | -------------------------------- |
| `open-change` | `onOpenChange` | `open: boolean, nativeEvent?: Event` | Emitted when open state changes. |

## Slots

| Slot      | Description                                |
| --------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| `default` | Toast title, description and close action. |

## Examples

### React styled usage

```tsx
import {
  Toast,
  ToastClose,
  ToastDescription,
  ToastTitle,
} from '@/components/ui/toast'

export function Example() {
  return (
    <Toast defaultOpen>
      <ToastTitle>Deployment complete</ToastTitle>
      <ToastDescription>The build is live.</ToastDescription>
      <ToastClose>Dismiss</ToastClose>
    </Toast>
  )
}
```
